leadText: Volume 5 is the fifth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 5 is the fifth volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 14 - Defeating Stoutland
Adventure 15 - The Mystery of the Missing Fossil
Adventure 16 - A Direct Attack and a Daunting Defense
Adventure 17 - Lost in the Big City

==Gym battles==
